read_path_control.phrase: carries the break record's chain hash

measured_absence.phrase: carries the checkpoint record's chain hash

finding: chain_break has an explicit successor-linkage sentence; checkpoint has none, and the checkpoint record carries its head in predicate.checkpoint.previousHash rather than in the predicate.chain.previousHash the Fields table defines as the chain link. A verifier that walks the documented field steps straight past every checkpoint, so deleting a checkpoint breaks no documented linkage. The checkpoint is the whole anti-truncation mechanism.
